environment.pacing: GT4_PACING unset or paced (default): paced clock. GT4_PACING=audio: blocking WinMM clock as in slice152. toolchain.build: CMake/Ninja VS2022 x64 ABI Windows SDK10.0.26100.0

classification: TASK-041 performance of the PCSX2 GS path (slice196 plus game-side changes only). GT4_MTVU_PRIV_ASYNC (default 1): in pcsx2 mode a privileged GS register write no longer drains the VU1 worker; it is queued in the MTVU journal behind the outstanding worker output, so its stream position is unchanged (CSR/IMR/SIGLBLID stay local on the EE). The MTVU journal moves single-chunk worker GIF records instead of copying them twice. F8 [gs-ipc]: privileged writes and the MTVU wait before them by register, GS process wake-ups, the GS CPU thread over the interval (STATS deltas) and a one-line EE critical path summary against the 16.68 ms budget. GT4_MTVU_PRIV_ASYNC=0 restores the slice196 synchronous path.
preserved_inputs: Same runtime capsule (slice191-gs-stream-runtime), port (slice191-gs-stream-port), shaders (slice153-pacing-shaders), EE library, VU1 and VU0 tables and gt4-gs package as slice196; changed: native/mtvu_runtime.*, native/mtvu_journal.*, native/mtvu_bridge.cpp, native/gs_stream/gs_stream_client.*, native/gs_stream/gs_stream_ipc.* (wake counter), native/perf_probe.* (CPU ms/frame for the report hooks).
limits: Unsynchronized readbacks answer from the PCSX2 GS local memory copy: GPU-drawn pixels are stale (zeros in the gs_live_check sprite test), so the night-race lens flare may change; accurate is the default.
Deferred swap chain acquire and detached input queues are checked only with hidden windows; the owner checks the visible window (fullscreen, Alt+Tab, minimize).
Interlaced races (480i held) and the 1080i/PAL modes are not checked; only the 480i menus capture (slice191 stream) was replayed headless.
gt4-gs.exe still contains the PCSX2 recompilers and the software renderer JIT (TASK-042).
Save states are refused in pcsx2 mode.
GT4_MTVU_PRIV_ASYNC is proven equivalent (identical stream bytes, identical frames) on the recorded headless schedules only; race scenes are checked by the owner F8 A/B.
